item.title: Iran conflict expands as Senate again rejects effort to limit Trump's war powers
item.description: A vote in the Senate to limit President Trump's war powers has narrowly failed again. Three Republicans voted in favor of it.

item.title: Ukrainian ambassador tracks how Kyiv's relationship with D.C. has evolved,
item.description: The outgoing Ukrainian ambassador to the U.S. says Ukraine has been able to combat what she said characterized as a prior, erroneous narrative that Russia was winning the war, now in its fifth year​.

item.title: Anthropic reveals Claude "gained unauthorized access" to "real-world systems"
item.description: Anthropic's artificial intelligence model Claude "gained unauthorized access" to three outside organizations on three separate occasions during testing.

item.title: Trump says he may pull Blanche's nomination until 2 Senate critics leave office
item.description: President Trump said Todd Blanche will remain acting attorney general as a holdup on his nomination continues.

item.title: U.S. investigating if Iran was behind cyberattack on Minnesota water systems
item.description: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at more than 30 community water systems across Minnesota this week, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Pentagon weighs eliminating civilian tenure at military academies, draft memo says
item.description: The Pentagon is considering a sweeping remake of military higher education, including an end to civilian tenure and a "line-by-line" review of courses, according to a draft memo obtained by CBS News.

item.title: Trump says Hamas agreed to next phase of Gaza peace deal, including disarmament
item.description: President Trump said Hamas and his international "Board of Peace" have agreed on the next steps in a peace deal that includes Hamas' disarmament in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: What the fires burning near Bordeaux's vineyards could mean for France's wine industry
item.description: In France, wildfires this summer have already burned an area four times the size of Paris, driving hundreds of thousands of people from their homes.

item.title: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" swings into theaters as other superhero franchises stall
item.description: Just weeks after "Supergirl" underperformed at the box office, the ninth live-action Spider-Man film since 2002 is expected to premiere with a projected global opening of as much as $465 million. Marlow Stern, chief correspondent at Variety, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Hair sample found at Nancy Guthrie's home inconclusive as search hits 6-month mark
item.description: A hair sample found at the home of Nancy Guthrie came back inconclusive after undergoing testing, Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos revealed Thursday.

item.title: Instead of selling his luxury boat company for millions, he invested in his employees
item.description: Eddie Smith, the owner of Grady-White Boats, could have sold his business for hundreds of millions of dollars. Instead, he decided to turn the company over to a charitable trust.

item.title: Legal analysis on whether states or the federal government decide election rules
item.description: President Trump is fighting with 23 states and the District of Columbia over election rules and mail-in ballots. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson joins to discuss.

item.title: Pima County sheriff says he is optimistic about Nancy Guthrie's case "based on all the evidence"
item.description: Nearly six months after Nancy Guthrie was kidnapped from her home in Tucson, Arizona, Jonathan Vigliotti sat down with the sheriff at the forefront of the investigation.

item.title: WNBA sees sideline controversy over trans athletes in sports after Cunningham comments
item.description: Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham made news off the court for her recent comments about transgender athletes in women's sports. Jan Crawford has more.

item.title: U.S.-Iran war widens further after drone strikes on Egyptian port
item.description: U.S. Central Command released new video it said to show fighter jets launching what it described as a "heavy wave" of strikes against Iran. It was the first resumption of strikes in several days. The U.S. said it was in direct retaliation for the recent missile attack on U.S. forces in Jordan. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: ICE agents increasingly arresting immigrants at U.S. airports
item.description: ICE agents have ramped up arrests at some U.S. airports, working with the TSA to crack down on travelers at check-in counters and even at the departure gates. Camilo Montoya-Galvez has the story.

item.title: El-Sayed leading Stevens in Michigan Democratic primary for Senate, poll finds
item.description: A new Emerson College poll shows Dr. Abdul El-Sayed leading Rep. Haley Stevens in Michigan's Democratic primary for a U.S. Senate seat. CBS News' Fin Gomez has more on that race and some of the other 2026 midterm battles.

item.title: Spain deploys military to Morocco border after migrant crossings, 9 deaths
item.description: Spain will deploy its military to Ceuta to help restore order at its border with Morocco after local authorities in Ceuta had asked the central government in Madrid for reinforcements.

item.title: Trump suggests he may pause Blanche's confirmation amid GOP pushback
item.description: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche's confirmation is on hold after some Republican senators refused to vote for him. President Trump suggested that he may press pause on the nomination. Nikole Killion has more details.

item.title: CBS News poll: Many Americans don't see inflation relief coming from either side of political aisle
item.description: As the perceived disparity between incomes and inflation continues to grow, new CBS News polling shows many Americans don't feel relief coming from Republicans or Democrats. CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto breaks down the findings.

item.title: Stolen Civil War-era cannonballs found in suitcase at Alabama airport
item.description: Law enforcement officials say a set of stolen Civil War-era cannonballs was discovered in a passenger's suitcase during a routine security screening at Alabama's Gulf Shores International Airport.

item.title: 7/30: CBS Evening News
item.description: Mass migration triggers a military response in the Spanish city of Ceuta; a powerful explosion destroys an Ohio home.

item.title: Rep. Ralph Norman says he expects South Carolina GOP Senate primary to go to runoff amid tight polls
item.description: A new poll from Emerson College shows a tight race to fill the late Lindsey Graham's Senate seat. Rep. Ralph Norman, who the poll showed with a slim lead over Graham's sister, Darline, joins "The Takeout" to discuss his campaign.

item.title: Father of Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
item.description: Colin Gray gets 15 years in prison after emotional sentencing hearing in Apalachee High School shooting case.

item.title: Europe facing "brunt of climate change impacts" as wildfires continue to burn, professor explains
item.description: Tens of thousands of people are returning home in Southern France as firefighters make progress battling wildfires there. Meanwhile, parts of Spain are still burning, but the national emergency for fires near Madrid was called off. Scott Stephens, a professor of fire science and forest policy at UC Berkeley, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Netflix sued for allegedly losing unreleased Nicolas Cage movie
item.description: Lawsuit alleges that a drive storing $45 million spy film starring Nicolas Cage was "stolen right off a Netflix desk."

item.title: European teams boycott FIFA over plan to sell World Cup stake to investors
item.description: A source close to Joshua Kushner's firm tells CBS News there's no politics behind FIFA's bid to draw private investment, but Europe's soccer powerhouses are crying foul.

item.title: Saudi, Israeli leaders try to shape Trump's decisions on Iran conflict
item.description: As conflict potentially expands in the region, Trump met with the Saudi defense minister and with Benjamin Netanyahu. The Israeli prime minister counseled Trump on three options for the war.

item.title: 7/30: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Cornyn and Tillis meet with Blanche amid hold on AG nomination; details on where U.S.-Iran talks stand as war appears to expand to Egypt.

item.title: Senate committee advances Dr. Erica Schwartz to be Trump's CDC director
item.description: If confirmed by the full Senate, Dr. Erica Schwartz would become the 22nd director of the Atlanta-based Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
